kurz: Quinoa carries a bitter, soapy coating (saponins) on its shell: rinse briefly, then cook at a ratio of 1 to 2.
bild_im_kopf: Like soap left on freshly washed dishes: a quick rinse, and nothing tastes bitter any more.
was_passiert: The plant protects its seeds from birds and insects with saponins. These compounds taste bitter and foam in water like soap. Most quinoa sold is pre-washed, but traces often remain.
warum_wichtig: Bitter quinoa is the most common reason people dislike it. A sieve and a minute change that.
faustregeln: For more flavour: toast briefly in a dry pan after rinsing.
It is done when the small white germ ring separates from the grain.
schritte: Put the quinoa in a fine sieve and rinse under running water until no more foam forms.
Bring to the boil with twice the amount of water and a little salt.
Cover and simmer gently for about 12 to 15 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Take off the heat, rest covered for 5 minutes, fluff up with a fork.
